back.en: Phospholipid bilayer with proteins, cholesterol and glycoproteins that can move
back.bm: Dwilapisan fosfolipid dengan protein, kolesterol dan glikoprotein yang boleh bergerak

back.en: Hydrophilic (water-loving) head, two hydrophobic (water-fearing) fatty-acid tails
back.bm: Kepala hidrofilik (suka air), dua ekor asid lemak hidrofobik (takut air)

back.en: Channel: pore for ions/water. Carrier: binds and changes shape to move molecules (glucose, ions)
back.bm: Liang: liang untuk ion/air. Pembawa: terikat dan berubah bentuk untuk menggerakkan molekul (glukosa, ion)

back.en: High → low concentration through the bilayer; no energy (O₂, CO₂, lipids)
back.bm: Kepekatan tinggi → rendah melalui dwilapisan; tanpa tenaga (O₂, CO₂, lipid)

back.en: Down the gradient via carrier/channel proteins; no energy (glucose, amino acids, ions)
back.bm: Mengikut kecerunan melalui protein pembawa/liang; tanpa tenaga (glukosa, asid amino, ion)

back.en: Against the gradient; carrier protein + ATP (e.g. sodium-potassium pump)
back.bm: Melawan kecerunan; protein pembawa + ATP (cth. pam natrium-kalium)

back.en: Bulk transport using vesicles: in (phagocytosis by white blood cells) or out (secreting enzymes)
back.bm: Pengangkutan pukal menggunakan vesikel: masuk (fagositosis oleh sel darah putih) atau keluar (merembes enzim)

back.en: More dilute than cell sap: animal cell bursts (haemolysis); plant cell turgid
back.bm: Lebih cair daripada sap sel: sel haiwan pecah (hemolisis); sel tumbuhan segah

back.en: More concentrated: animal cell shrinks (crenation); plant cell plasmolysed
back.bm: Lebih pekat: sel haiwan mengecut (krenasi); sel tumbuhan plasmolisis

back.en: Same concentration — no net water movement; plant cell flaccid
back.bm: Kepekatan sama — tiada pergerakan air bersih; sel tumbuhan flasid

front.en: Preserving food with salt or sugar
front.bm: Mengawet makanan dengan garam atau gula

back.en: Hypertonic — draws water out of microorganisms, so they die
back.bm: Hipertonik — menarik air keluar dari mikroorganisma, menyebabkannya mati

back.en: Salt + sugar + water — restores water and ions after diarrhoea
back.bm: Garam + gula + air — memulihkan air dan ion selepas cirit-birit

back.en: Net movement of water molecules from a dilute solution to a more concentrated one through a semi-permeable membrane
back.bm: Pergerakan bersih molekul air dari larutan cair ke larutan lebih pekat melalui membran separa telap

tip.en: Osmosis is diffusion of WATER only.

front.en: How root hairs take in mineral ions
front.bm: Cara rambut akar menyerap ion mineral

back.en: By active transport — against the concentration gradient using ATP
back.bm: Melalui pengangkutan aktif — melawan kecerunan kepekatan menggunakan ATP

tip.en: Water enters root hairs by osmosis; ions need energy.
tip.bm: Air memasuki rambut akar secara osmosis; ion memerlukan tenaga.

back.en: O₂ and CO₂ cross the thin wall by simple diffusion down their concentration gradients
back.bm: O₂ dan CO₂ merentasi dinding nipis secara resapan ringkas mengikut kecerunan kepekatan

example.en: O₂: alveolus → blood. CO₂: blood → alveolus.
example.bm: O₂: alveolus → darah. CO₂: darah → alveolus.
